scope: Project-internal Grace assets, two existing modules and dedicated texture-group config migrated to Re9PackageDemo. External source files remain in place.

complete_object_comparison.scope: Complete generic UObject exports. Function object block emission order differs, but every object declaration and ordered property list is identical. GUID checks preserve all non-GUID text and require a bijection across all repeated references. Array indices, order, pin connections, values and control-flow content are retained. This is not a GPU or PIE equivalence claim.

native_resave_notes: Six Blueprint/AnimBlueprint assets regenerated graph, node and pin GUIDs; three materials regenerated StateId and LightingGuid after description path updates.

Preview level's serialized instance acquired the existing Blueprint's FlashlightMesh and FlashlightSpotLight components and dynamic face material. Original and migrated worlds are identical after the same in-memory Blueprint compile/reconstruction. The verification compile used SkipSave.
The preview level no longer directly imports the Lighter mesh; its character Blueprint still references that mesh.
Six Flashlight texture registry tags changed empty-filename AssetImportData records to empty arrays through UE serialization; resolved source paths did not change.
SK_Grace_Default RE9MergeSources metadata remains unchanged. Its seven original component identifiers were already absent as assets before migration and are not hard/soft dependencies.
One Named Reroute color was explicitly restored from the original baseline export and verified in a fresh process. It was not taken from a subsequent random-default load of the source asset.
known_limitations: Baseline and migrated character Blueprint loads both emit the existing SimpleConstructionScript.cpp:474 handled ensure and component reparenting warnings; full audit commandlets return 1 despite all 533 asset-level loads/exports succeeding.
LocalWind is enabled in the pre-existing project config but has no loadable binary; only verification commandlines disable it. Normal editor startup with all project plugins enabled was not verified.

No C++ build, Shader compilation, PIE interaction, visual material-editor inspection, rendered image comparison, GPU timing or packaging was performed. UE asset compilation was explicitly authorized only for this migration and its verification.
Existing native module binaries load from the new plugin location; this task did not compile current source changes into them.
